statement: Cemu handles every 0x20, without prior-bit comparison, with IR configuration, conditional EEPROM 0016 and A600FA/6 MP probes; with status extension bit and unknown normal extension it writes A400F0=55, A400FB=00, reads A400FA/6; on disconnected it resets normal extension state. Absent a new status, these status-conditional retries do not happen, although initialization paths may. No A400F6 probe is present.
